patches.field: terms[2](脆弱性関連情報届出制度).analogy_jp
patches.before: 建物の欠陥に気付いた人が、うわさを広める前に管理会社へ知らせ、補修の段取りがついてから住人へ告知されるのに似ている。
patches.after: 市販の家電の欠陥に気付いた人が、うわさを広める前に窓口へ知らせ、メーカーの修理の段取りがついてから利用者へ告知されるのに似ている。

patches.field: terms[2](脆弱性関連情報届出制度).analogy_zh
patches.before: 就像有人发现了建筑缺陷，不先到处传播，而是告诉物业公司，等维修安排好之后再通知住户。
patches.after: 就像有人发现了市售家电的缺陷，不先到处传播，而是告诉受理窗口，等厂家安排好修理之后再通知用户。

patches.field: terms[2](脆弱性関連情報届出制度).analogy_en
patches.before: It is like someone who spots a defect in a building telling the management company before spreading rumors, with residents informed only once repairs are arranged.
patches.after: It is like someone who spots a defect in a household appliance telling a contact point before spreading rumors, with users informed only once the maker has arranged a fix.

patches.before: (ソフトウェア製品は JVN で公表する)
patches.after: (ソフトウェア製品の弱点は JVN で公表する)

patches.before: （软件产品在 JVN 上公布）
patches.after: （软件产品的弱点在 JVN 上公布）
(weaknesses in software products are published on JVN)

patches.before: they no longer need to check safety separately each time they procure.
patches.after: they spend less effort checking safety separately each time they procure.

patches.before: 正式名には「標的型攻撃に対する」という意味の語句が入っており、
patches.after: 正式名 Cyber Rescue and Advice Team against targeted attack of Japan には「標的型攻撃に対する」という意味の語句 (against targeted attack) が入っており、

patches.field: terms[6](サイバーレスキュー隊).detail_zh
patches.before: 正式名称中含有“针对定向攻击”这一意思的词句，
patches.after: 正式名称 Cyber Rescue and Advice Team against targeted attack of Japan 中含有“针对定向攻击”这一意思的词句（against targeted attack），

patches.field: terms[6](サイバーレスキュー隊).detail_en
patches.before: The official name includes wording meaning "against targeted attacks", so the name itself shows which attacks it supports against.
patches.after: The official name, Cyber Rescue and Advice Team against targeted attack of Japan, includes the words "against targeted attack", so the name itself shows which kind of attack it helps organizations deal with.
